Portland General Electric Company Third Revision of Sheet No. 120-1
P.U.C. Oregon No. E-19 Canceling Second Revision of Sheet No. 120-1
SCHEDULE 120
SEASIDE BATTERY STORAGE RESOURCE ALTERNATIVE RECOVERY
PURPOSE
This Schedule recovers the revenue requirement and provides customers with the Power Cost
benefits associated with Seaside Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) resource.
AVAILABLE
In all territory served by the Company.
APPLICABLE
To all bills for Electricity Service except Schedules 76, 485, 489, 490, 491, 492, 495, 496, 515, (C)
532, 538, 549, 575, 576, 583, 585, 589, 596, 689 and 696. (C)
PART A – REVENUE REQUIREMENT ADJUSTMENTS
Part A will include the fixed costs of the Seaside BESS resource associated and associated
transmission (including return on and return of the capital costs), operation and maintenance
costs, income taxes, property taxes, and other fees and costs that are applicable to the Seaside
BESS resource.
PART B – POWER COST BENEFIT
Part B consists of the Net Variable Power Cost benefits from the Seaside BESS resource, until
the benefits are included in the Annual Power Cost Update Schedule 125. Until the benefits are
included in the Annual Power Cost Update Schedule 125, the net revenue requirements of the
Seaside BESS resource will be included in the Schedule 120 rates. By no later than December 1
of 2025, the Company will file an update to this schedule to remove the power cost benefit for the
following year and include the benefit in the AUT.
ADJUSTMENT RATE
The Adjustment Rate, applicable for service on and after the effective date of this schedule are:

SPECIAL CONDITIONS
1. Costs recovered through this schedule will be allocated to each schedule using the
applicable schedule’s forecasted energy on the basis of an equal percent of generation
revenue applied on a cents per kWh basis to each applicable rate schedule.
2. The costs for projects included under this schedule will be updated annually as provided
above and will continue to be recovered under Schedule 120 until such time as the costs
are included in base rates or the project is no longer in service.
3. Once the Seaside resource is placed into base rates or is no longer in service, this Schedule
will be withdrawn, and no other assets will be placed within this Schedule.
Advice No. 26-24
